per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: `MergeOutcome`'s `wave-walled` arm states the wall as any throw the merge stage holds, not a refused ledger rewrite alone; the sibling narrowings named in notes move with it; the pin below is green.
pins: records a wave-walled row for a span that settled after a merge-stage wall no ledger refused
notes: `MergeOutcome` is exports-reachable, so the arm is hover text a chain routes on. `foldUncarriedAttempt` (`src/waveMerge.ts`) rows on `mergeError`, which holds every throw out of `mergeAttempt` — a marker write, a prior-attempt record, a revParse. Sibling narrowings, same commit: `TickVerdictFacts.headSha` and `buildTickVerdict`'s own doc (`src/tickVerdict.ts`), and the verdict-build comment in `src/Dispatcher.ts`.
